'''''Phanera yunnanensis''''' ([[taxonomic synonym]] ''Bauhinia yunnanensis'') is a plant with the [[common name]]s '''Chinese orchid tree''', '''Yunnan orchid''' or '''orchid vine''', native to China (Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou) and W. [[Indochina]].<ref name=POWO>[https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:77113367-1 Plants of the World Online]: ''Phanera yunnanensis'' (Franch.) Wunderlin</ref><ref name=ILDIS>{{cite web | title = ''Bauhinia yunnanensis'' | url = http://www.legumes-online.net/ildis/aweb/td100/td_21166.htm | work = International Legume Database & Information Service (ILDIS) | accessdate = 31 October 2020}}</ref>  It is a perennial [[dicot]] described as a [[shrub]] or vine.<ref name=usda>{{Cite web|url=http://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile?symbol=BAYU|title=Plants Profile for ''Bauhinia yunnanensis'' (Yunnan bauhinia)|website=plants.usda.gov}}</ref> It is in the [[Fabaceae]] family,<ref name=usda/> has orchid-like flowers<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://herbarium.biol.sc.edu/floracaroliniana/taxa/index.php?taxon=22613|title=Flora Caroliniana - ''Bauhinia yunnanensis''|website=herbarium.biol.sc.edu}}{{Dead link|date=December 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> and has been introduced to [[Florida]], in the USA.<ref name=usda/>
